provenance.label: SYNTHETIC / DEMO-ONLY
provenance.description: Hand-authored aggregate events for an invented Signal Desk preview cohort. No real telemetry, users, tenants, or customer content are included.
limitations: Small fictional cohort and short observation window
No control group, statistical inference, or causal attribution
Event counts are illustrative and may contain repeat actions by the same synthetic user
Free-text view names and filter values are intentionally excluded

signals.name: saved_view_created
signals.interpretation: Some active users tried creation, but most eligible users did not.
signals.tension: Low adoption could mean low value, poor discoverability, or a narrow repeat-triage audience.

signals.name: saved_view_opened
signals.interpretation: Most creators reopened at least one view during the window.
signals.tension: The aggregate does not distinguish deliberate reuse from repeated prototype testing.

signals.name: saved_view_opened_later_session
signals.interpretation: Twelve creators show directional cross-session reuse.
signals.tension: Browser-local storage means this cannot reveal cross-device need.

signals.name: filters_changed_after_view_open
signals.interpretation: Saved configurations may serve as starting points rather than fixed destinations.
signals.tension: Edits might instead indicate stale or incorrect saved state.

signals.name: saved_view_deleted
signals.interpretation: Deletion is used and should remain easy and recoverable.
signals.tension: The synthetic event model does not capture why a view was deleted.

signals.name: saved_view_storage_parse_error
signals.interpretation: Local state can fail and requires a safe recovery path.
signals.tension: The sample is too small to estimate a reliable failure rate.

signals.name: mobile_saved_view_opened
signals.interpretation: Opening on a narrow viewport is plausible.
signals.tension: There are no synthetic mobile creation events; instrumentation coverage may be incomplete.

proposedMetricDefinitions.name: laterSessionReuseRate
proposedMetricDefinitions.definition: Unique creators who open a view in a later session divided by unique creators.

proposedMetricDefinitions.name: creatorPenetration
proposedMetricDefinitions.definition: Unique creators divided by active Feedback users.
